answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Dawah & Tableeg Question ID: 1570 Country: India Title: What is the opinion of deoband on the tableegh jamaat and listening & joining them 2) what is ur view about dr israr ahmed of pakistan? Question: What is the opinion of deoband on the tableegh jamaat and listening & joining them 2) what is ur view about dr israr ahmed of pakistan? Answer ID: 1570 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 519/521=M) (1) According to Deoband Ulama, Tableeghi Jamat is a true Jamat which is among the Ahl-e-Sunnah wal-Jamat (the mainstream Muslims) and following the maslak of Deoband. This Jamat is very much concerned and sincere for the reformation of the Ummah. It is very useful to listen their talks and join them with intention of self reform. (2) Ask the Ulama of Pakistan regarding Dr. Asrar Sahib; we are not aware of his ideas and beliefs. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
